title: Special Marine Warning issued July 27 at 1:55PM EDT until July 27 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
description: The affected areas were... Coastal Waters from Cape Charles Light to Virginia-North Carolina border out 20 NM... Currituck Sound... The thunderstorm has weakened and no longer poses a significant wind threat. However, occasional cloud to ground lightning is still expected with this storm.
